manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Shows that a tossed ball experiences constant downward gravitational acceleration -g even at its highest point where vertical velocity is zero.
manifest.description: Left, a ball on a vertical height scale shows height, velocity and acceleration vectors, and gravitational force. Right, a plot of velocity against time shows a line of constant negative slope -g through v = 0.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
